sammendrag: Using a large longitudinal administrative database of Canadian workers, we estimate the long-term impact on earnings of attending post-secondary education institutions following job loss. To do so, we implement a difference-indifference model. The results suggest that over the period spanning five years prior and nine years following job loss, workers who attended post-secondary education shortly following displacement saw their earnings increase by almost $7,000 more than displaced workers who did not. Significant benefits are found by sex, age, marital status, and union coverage, with the exception of the older group of men we examine (between 35 and 44 years old). Despite the benefits of education, we find that job displacement is associated with only a modest increase in post-secondary education attendance for all groups examined.
tittel: The Long-Term Earnings Impact of Education Following Job Loss
